name: Bertaga Son Kissed Vineyards
description: Bertaga Son Kissed Vineyards is an agritourism farm in 3363 Hegan lane, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
